--admin.help: Add the user with admin privileges.

--basic_auth_password.help: HTTP basic auth password (will be used if basic_auth_username is set).

--basic_auth_username.help: HTTP basic auth username (HTTP basic auth will be used if this flag is set).

--batch.help: Size of batches processed by each thread.

--build_msi.help: Enable building of an MSI template.

--checkpoint_every.help: Flush the results every time after processing this number of values.

--cloud_storage_output_bucket.help: If defined, build products will be copied to this cloud storage bucket.

--cloud_storage_sdist_bucket.help: If defined, copy sdists from this bucket rather than building them.

--common_name.help: The common name to use for the cert.

--config.help: Path to the config file to be used when building templates.

--depth.help: Depth of recursion when path is a directory.

--dump_client_info.help: Detect client paths and dump a yaml version of the client object to the root path. This is useful for seeing the hostname/users of the machine the client id refers to.

--enable_rekall.help: Enable Rekall during noninteractive config initialization.

--exec_code.help: If present, no console is started but the code given in the flag is run instead (comparable to the -c option of IPython). The code will be able to use a predefined global 'grrapi' object.

--exec_file.help: If present, no console is started but the code given in command file is supplied as input instead. The code will be able to use a predefined global 'grrapi' object.

--expect_service_running.help: Triggers whether after installation the GRR service should be running or not. Used for testing the installation.

--flatten.help: Create a 'files' folder in the output folder with flat list of symlinks pointing to all the found files.

--fleetspeak_service_config.help: Service config file to use with Fleetspeak.

--grr_src.help: Location of the grr src code. If it doesn't exist  at this path we'll try to check it out from github.

--gsutil.help: gsutil binary. The default is the SDK install location since that's likely the one the user has authorized their creds for

--input_file.help: Input textproto file with commands to generate signatures for.

--keylength.help: The key length for the new server key. Defaults to the Server.rsa_key_length config option.

--mypy-protobuf.help: A path to the mypy protobuf generator plugin.

--mysql_ca_cert_path.help: The path name of the Certificate Authority (CA) certificate file.

--mysql_client_cert_path.help: The path name of the client public key certificate file.

--mysql_client_key_path.help: The path name of the client private key file.

--mysql_db.help: Name of GRR's MySQL database (only applies if --noprompt is set).

--mysql_fleetspeak_db.help: Name of Fleetspeak's MySQL database (only applies if --noprompt is set).

--mysql_hostname.help: Hostname for a running MySQL instance (only appplies if --noprompt is set).

--mysql_password.help: Password for GRR MySQL database user (only applies if --noprompt is set).

--mysql_port.help: Port for a running MySQL instance (only applies if --noprompt is set).

--mysql_username.help: Name of GRR MySQL database user (only applies if --noprompt is set).

--no-check-certificate.help: If set, don't verify server's SSL certificate.

--noprompt.help: Set to avoid prompting during initialize.

--norepack_templates.help: Skip template repacking during noninteractive config initialization.

--noupload.help: Don't upload the client binaries to the datastore.

--output.help: The path to write the output template.

--output_file.help: Where to write the new template with signed libs.

--page_size.help: Page size used when paging through collections of items.

--path.help: Path to the RDFValueCollection. Files referenced in this collection will be downloaded.

--platform.help: The platform the file will be used on. This determines which signing keys to use, and the path on the server the file will be uploaded to.

--python32_dir.help: Path to the 32 bit Python installation.

--python64_dir.help: Path to the 64 bit Python installation.

--python_out.help: Where to put compiled protos. Default: next to source files.

--redownload_templates.help: Re-download templates during noninteractive config initialization (server debs already include templates).

--regenerate.help: If true prunes the database of existing signatures before writing.

--repack_configs.help: The list of repacking configs to apply. Use '--repack_configs /some/dir/*.yaml' to repack with all configs in a directory

--share_dir.help: Path to the directory containing grr data.

--signed_template.help: Set to true if template was signed with sign_template. This is only necessary when repacking a windows template many times.

--templates.help: The list of templates to repack. Use '--template /some/dir/*.zip' to repack all templates in a directory.

--test_repack_install.help: Test repacking by calling repack on the template after building,then try and install the result. For use by integration tests. If you use this option you must run as admin.

--threads.help: Maximum number of threads to use.

--upload_subdirectory.help: Directory path under which to place an uploaded python-hack or executable, e.g. for a Windows executable named 'hello.exe', if --upload_subdirectory is set to 'test', the path of the uploaded binary will be 'windows/test/hello.exe', relative to the root path for executables.

--use_rel_db.help: Use the new-generation datastore (REL_DB). Deprecated, REL_DB is now the only available choice.

--username.help: Username to display. If not specified, list all users.

--version.help: Print config updater version number and exit immediately.

--virtualenv_32bit.help: Optional path to a 32-bit Python virtualenv to be used instead of creating a new one.

--virtualenv_64bit.help: Optional path to a 64-bit Python virtualenv to be used instead of creating a new one.

--wheel_dir.help: A directory that will be passed to pip as the wheel-dir parameter.

delete_artifacts.help: Delete a list of artifacts from the data store.

download_missing_rekall_profiles.help: Downloads all Rekall profiles from the repository that are not currently present in the database.

generate_command_signatures_from_file.help: Generate signatures for all given commands.

generate_keys.help: Generate crypto keys in the configuration.

initialize.help: Run all the required steps to setup a new GRR install.

repack_clients.help: Repack the clients binaries with the current configuration.

repack_multiple.help: Repack multiple templates with multiple configs.

show_user.help: Display user settings or list all users.

sign_template.help: Sign client libraries in a client template.Use this when you are repacking a windows template many times and need all binaries inside signed.

switch_datastore.help: Switch from a legacy datastore (AFF4) to the new optimized implementation (REL_DB).

upload_artifact.help: Upload a raw json artifact file.

upload_exe.help: Sign and upload an executable which can be used to execute code on a client.

upload_python.help: Sign and upload a 'python hack' which can be used to execute code on a client.

version.help: Print config updater version number and exit immediately
